shortDescription: Collect all the cheese in the maze and dodge the cats in this classic arcade!

faq.question: How do I play?
faq.answer: Guide the mouse: collect the cheese on the map and dodge the cats. When you collect all the cheese, the level is complete.

faq.question: Do I need internet?
faq.answer: No. The game is fully offline and does not require an internet connection.

faq.question: Is the game free? Are there ads or purchases?
faq.answer: Yes, the game is free. There are no in-app purchases and no ads.

faq.question: How many levels are there?
faq.answer: 41 levels: eight worlds with five maps each and a final level. Every world has its own look.

faq.question: How do I control the mouse on a phone?
faq.answer: With swipes: drag your finger up, down, left, or right to set the direction of movement.

faq.question: What happens if a cat catches the mouse?
faq.answer: The mouse loses one life and is moved to a safe part of the maze. When your lives run out, the level restarts.

faq.question: How do I get an extra life?
faq.answer: Some maps have hearts on them. Picking up a heart gives you an extra life.

faq.question: Is my progress saved?
faq.answer: Yes. The game remembers the level you stopped at, and you can continue from there after launching the game.

faq.question: Which devices are supported?
faq.answer: Android 7.0 and newer, on phones and tablets.

faq.question: How are the cats different?
faq.answer: Each cat has its own personality: one chases the mouse, one patrols the corridors, one moves at random, and one lies in ambush.
